sequences.story: The players execute various high-stakes robberies, including a bar and a bank, accumulate money, engage in rooftop escapes, steal vehicles from an airport, and try out quirky activities like meditation and exploring cruise ships before pulling off daring stunts.

Lucia helps her mother clean up their dilapidated property, survives an alligator attack in the pool, deals with an armed gang confrontation, and ultimately uses an excavator to demolish the gang's house in retaliation.
A comprehensive walkthrough covering multiple early game mistakes in GTA VI, from vehicle upgrades and manual saves to criminal profiles, weapon management, and store robberies.

Jason visits an NPC to receive a snap gun, handles phone transactions and messages in his car, and then executes a heist at Donovan Banks & Co. to crack a safe for an amethyst necklace while evading police.

The sequence follows an intense escape from a hangar through swampy terrain and wooded areas, featuring continuous gunfights with law enforcement, tactical positioning, and eventual extraction via aircraft.
The player hunts a crocodile, encounters a mysterious vine-covered figure in the woods, drives around Grassrivers, and handles wildlife inventory.

A sustained 6-star police chase beginning inside a military base, breaking out onto country roads, crossing bridges towards Vice City, battling N.O.O.S.E. units and helicopters, and eventually culminating in a 'wasted' screen after extensive damage.

A continuous sequence of open-world exploration and mission driving, starting with the auto-drive feature discovery, navigating through traffic and bridges, experiencing a severe collision, and arriving at the warehouse to talk to NPCs.
Lucia carjacks an Ocelot Jugular, drives to Watkins Auto Parts, and negotiates with Moses to prove her car boosting skills.
The sequence follows the player stealing a jet, performing chaotic low-altitude flights through the city, getting wasted, and then exploring street-level interactions with NPCs.
The player plans and executes a series of store robberies, handles police encounters, and manages money in an attempt to win the challenge.

The streamers execute multiple robberies across Vice City, transitioning from purchasing cheap weapons at pawn shops, cracking safes in backrooms, stealing jewelry, and navigating intense police chases through city streets.
A sustained 6-star wanted level tank rampage across the airport runway featuring continuous vehicle destruction, military response, and escalating chaos.
Lucia navigates a parking garage, steals a car while avoiding police search zones, drives through Vice City to a clothing store to change her outfit, and subsequently delivers stolen goods to Tyrone.

Jason performs various safehouse activities, including uncovering cash stashes under floorboards, repairing drywall, customizing outfits in the wardrobe, fixing damaged outdoor stairs, and finally driving away in his pickup truck.

Jason explores around his house, interacts with Lucia in the kitchen, gets into his yellow Vapid truck, drives through the neighborhood while using his in-game phone app, and heads to The Rusty Anchor bar to order drinks and meet up with contacts.

A comprehensive side-by-side comparison of vehicular physics between Grand Theft Auto VI and Grand Theft Auto IV, testing tire damage, water physics, weight transfer during steering, and rear-end crash deformations.

The player explores the docks, interacts with wildlife, strolls through downtown Vice City at sunset, visits clothing stores, hangs out in a club lounge, and ends up in an escalating police chase after stealing a tour bus.

Jason stashes his money under the floorboards, explores his living quarters, takes a phone call from Brian about rent collection, rides his motorcycle through Key Lento, and drives down the highway while taking another phone call.
The player navigates through various missions, evades police, steals vehicles, and completes objectives across the map.
Lucia and Jason infiltrate a Vice City tanning salon, distract the front desk, sneak into the back rooms, trap a target inside a tanning bed, and hack his phone to uncover reservation details.

Lucia navigates the motel complex, checks on her boyfriend Jason in room 06, visits Vicki in room 10 to negotiate for pain medication, smokes from a bong, pays Vicki money, and returns the pills to Jason.
Jason navigates through Vice City, completes mission objectives, engages in shootouts at a lab, manages phone messages regarding relationship status, and explores apartment buildings.
A complete street race sequence featuring high speeds, traffic dodging, dramatic crashes, and vehicle flips.
The sequence follows the player managing bank accounts, checking the map for robbery locations, navigating city traffic in a sports car, and receiving calls regarding the final mission preparations.

The player drives around Vice City, navigates to Randy's showroom, inspects delivered cars, earns financial bonuses for pristine condition, uses the RydeMe phone app to order transport, and later finds and clones a target Piccia Furia vehicle requested by Randy.

Jason alters his appearance, evades police by sleeping, works out, drives a damaged truck to sell collectibles at a pawn shop, and explores various side activities.

The player navigates through nighttime city streets on a motorcycle, opens the phone to check text messages, checks the in-game map for cartel heist missions, and continues cruising through Vice City while interacting with chat and listening to dialogue.
